system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: At 13:43 UTC, WS-BCARTER-01 accepted an RDP connection from 192.0.2.45 and logged on omar.haddad. The supplied environment context says remote administration is only performed from WS-OHADDAD-01, making this source and destination inconsistent with the stated practice.
At 13:46 UTC, the domain recorded creation of it_helper by omar.haddad, followed immediately by adding it_helper to the Administrators group.

At 13:46 UTC, WS-BCARTER-01 registered a task named Microsoft\Windows\HealthCheck under omar.haddad’s logon. Its hidden, encoded PowerShell action decodes to a command that retrieves and executes a script from http://192.0.2.45/a.ps1.
The account was not created at the alert’s approximate 13:42 time in the supplied records; the creation event is at 13:46:31 UTC, after the anomalous RDP logon.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records show task registration, but do not show whether the task ran or whether the referenced script was retrieved or executed.
The supplied records do not establish who controlled the RDP source address or whether omar.haddad’s credentials were compromised.
claims_not_established: Whether it_helper was subsequently used to log on or perform actions.
Whether the remote session and account changes were authorized by omar.haddad.
What the referenced script contains or whether it caused further impact.
additional_evidence_needed: Collect task scheduler operational and task-history events for Microsoft\Windows\HealthCheck, plus process, PowerShell, and network telemetry from WS-BCARTER-01 to determine whether the task or script ran.
Retrieve and safely analyze the script served at 192.0.2.45/a.ps1, if available, and identify related network activity.
Review domain-controller and workstation authentication records to establish the origin and authorization of the RDP session and the account changes.
Check the current status, group memberships, logon history, and subsequent activity of it_helper; preserve evidence before disabling or removing it.
